description: Canonical multi-source maritime port directory containing verified UNECE UN/LOCODE, NGA WPI, and Indian Major Port entities.

ports.name: Seattle
ports.provenance: NOAA Nautical Chart 18480 / Coast Pilot 7; Cape Flattery entrance gate to Strait of Juan de Fuca (48°30.0'N, 124°45.0'W). NGA Pub. 150 Index 50640.
ports.license: U.S. Federal Government Public Domain (17 U.S.C. § 105)
ports.access_limitations: Cape Flattery pilot boarding area / TSS entrance. Terminal berths in Elliott Bay are 125 NM inland via Puget Sound.

ports.name: Tacoma
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (47°16'N, 122°25'W). NGA Pub. 150 Index 50620. Major grain elevator and container terminal on Commencement Bay.
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / U.S. Public Domain
ports.access_limitations: Puget Sound pilotage required south of Port Townsend.

ports.name: Portland (OR)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (45°31'N, 122°41'W). NGA Pub. 150 Index 50780. Major export bulk grain terminal on Columbia and Willamette Rivers.
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / U.S. Public Domain
ports.access_limitations: Deep-draft Columbia River bar pilotage and river pilotage required (River Mile 101).

ports.name: Kalama
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (46°01'N, 122°51'W). NGA Pub. 150 Index 50800. Critical Pacific Northwest grain export elevator (Kalama Export Co. / TEMCO LLC).
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / U.S. Public Domain
ports.access_limitations: Columbia River Mile 75 deep-draft navigation channel (43-foot draft).

ports.name: Vancouver (WA)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (45°38'N, 122°41'W). NGA Pub. 150 Index 50790. Columbia River bulk grain and mineral export gateway.
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / U.S. Public Domain
ports.access_limitations: Columbia River Mile 106. Columbia River bar and river pilots required.

ports.name: Longview
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (46°08'N, 122°57'W). NGA Pub. 150 Index 50810. High-speed bulk export grain terminal (EGT LLC).
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / U.S. Public Domain
ports.access_limitations: Columbia River Mile 66.

ports.name: New Orleans
ports.provenance: USCG Light List Volume IV (Gulf Coast), 2024 Ed., LLNR 0425 / NOAA Nautical Chart 11361. Southwest Pass Entrance Lighted Horn Buoy SW (-89.4300, 28.9000). NGA Pub. 150 Index 51860.
ports.license: U.S. Federal Government Public Domain (17 U.S.C. § 105)
ports.access_limitations: Outer fairway entrance to Southwest Pass jetty channel. Mississippi River terminal berths at New Orleans (Mile 95 AHP) are ~90 NM inland.

ports.name: Baton Rouge
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (30°27'N, 91°11'W). NGA Pub. 150 Index 51830. Mississippi River Mile 228 AHP bulk grain and chemicals terminal.
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / U.S. Public Domain
ports.access_limitations: Mississippi River deep-draft limit (45-foot project depth). River pilotage required.

ports.name: Houston
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (29°45'N, 95°21'W). NGA Pub. 150 Index 51690. 50-mile Houston Ship Channel bulk and container hub.
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / U.S. Public Domain
ports.access_limitations: Galveston Bay and Houston Ship Channel pilotage required.

ports.name: Galveston
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (29°18'N, 94°47'W). NGA Pub. 150 Index 51680. Galveston Bay entrance grain elevator and cargo docks.
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / U.S. Public Domain
ports.access_limitations: Galveston-Texas City bar pilots required.

ports.name: Mobile
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (30°41'N, 88°03'W). NGA Pub. 150 Index 51990. Alabama State Port Authority bulk grain and coal terminal.
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / U.S. Public Domain
ports.access_limitations: Mobile Bay channel transit ~30 NM from outer sea buoy.

ports.name: South Louisiana (Reserve / Convent)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (30°03'N, 90°35'W). NGA Pub. 150 Index 51845. Largest grain export district in the United States by volume (Mile 118-168 AHP).
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / U.S. Public Domain
ports.access_limitations: Mississippi River channel navigation under New Orleans-Baton Rouge Steamship Pilots (NOBRA).

ports.name: Yokohama
ports.provenance: Japan Coast Guard Chart W1062 / Uraga Suido TSS southern entry gate (35°09.5'N, 139°44.0'E; 139.7300, 35.1500). NGA Pub. 150 Index 61440.
ports.license: Official Navigational Notice (Japan Coast Guard)
ports.access_limitations: Uraga Channel TSS deep-water entrance gate to Tokyo Bay. Inner transit to Honmoku and Daikoku terminals requires Tokyo Bay Pilotage.

ports.name: Chiba
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (35°36'N, 140°06'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 61420. Tokyo Bay major bulk grain silo and energy port.
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / Japanese Open Data
ports.access_limitations: Tokyo Wan TSS passage required.

ports.name: Nagoya
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (35°05'N, 136°53'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 61470. Ise Bay major grain discharge elevator and manufacturing gateway.
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / Japanese Open Data
ports.access_limitations: Irago Suido TSS and Ise Bay pilotage.

ports.name: Kobe
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (34°41'N, 135°12'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 61500. Hanshin port region major grain and bulk discharge docks.
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / Japanese Open Data
ports.access_limitations: Akashi Kaikyo / Tomogashima Suido traffic routes.

ports.name: Osaka
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (34°39'N, 135°26'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 61490. Osaka Bay major industrial and bulk discharge port.
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / Japanese Open Data
ports.access_limitations: Osaka Bay pilotage required for deep draft.

ports.name: Kawasaki
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (35°31'N, 139°45'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 61430. Keihin industrial zone grain milling and energy terminal.
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / Japanese Open Data
ports.access_limitations: Tokyo Bay passage and channel pilotage.

ports.name: Mumbai (Bombay)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (18°56'N, 72°50'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 44100. Mumbai Port Authority (MbPA) historic deepwater natural harbour on west coast of India.
ports.license: Government of India Open Data / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Prongs Reef approach channel; pilotage compulsory under Mumbai Port Authority.

aliases.source_name: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways

ports.name: Nhava Sheva (JNPT)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (18°57'N, 72°57'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 44105. Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority (JNPA), India's premier container and bulk maritime gateway.
ports.license: Government of India Open Data / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Main harbor channel transit; draft restrictions on tide-dependent berths.

ports.name: Kandla (Deendayal Port)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (23°00'N, 70°13'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 44020. Deendayal Port Authority, Gulf of Kutch, major hub for dry bulk grain, fertilizer, and crude oil.
ports.license: Government of India Open Data / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Tidal creek approach (Kandla Creek); pilotage mandatory.

ports.name: Mundra
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (22°45'N, 69°42'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 44025. Largest commercial private deep-water port in India, handling Capesize bulk and container vessels.
ports.license: Government of India Open Data / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Gulf of Kutch deep-draft channel; 17.5m draft capability.

ports.name: Chennai (Madras)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (13°05'N, 80°18'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 44250. Chennai Port Authority on Coromandel Coast of Bay of Bengal; major automotive and container hub.
ports.license: Government of India Open Data / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Artificial harbor protected by breakwaters; round-the-clock pilotage.

ports.name: Cochin (Kochi)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (09°58'N, 76°16'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 44180. Cochin Port Authority / Vallarpadam ICTT, strategically positioned along East-West international sea route.
ports.license: Government of India Open Data / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Ernakulam and Mattancherry channels; pilot boarding ground off Cochin Light.

ports.name: Visakhapatnam (Vizag)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (17°41'N, 83°17'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 44320. Visakhapatnam Port Authority, deepwater port on east coast handling iron ore, coking coal, and petroleum.
ports.license: Government of India Open Data / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Outer harbour dredged to 18.1m; accommodates Capesize vessels up to 200,000 DWT.

ports.name: Paradip
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (20°16'N, 86°41'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 44360. Paradip Port Authority, premier dry bulk port in Odisha handling coastal thermal coal and iron ore.
ports.license: Government of India Open Data / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Artificial lagoon harbor; entrance channel 18.7m depth.

ports.name: Kolkata (Calcutta)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (22°32'N, 88°19'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 44390. Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, oldest operating riverine port in India on Hooghly River.
ports.license: Government of India Open Data / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Hooghly river pilotage required (126 nautical miles from Sandheads). Strict draft limitations.

ports.name: Tuticorin (V.O. Chidambaranar)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (08°45'N, 78°11'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 44220. V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority, Gulf of Mannar deepwater port.
ports.license: Government of India Open Data / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Artificial deep-sea harbour; approach channel protected by twin breakwaters.

ports.name: Mormugao (Goa)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (15°25'N, 73°48'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 44140. Mormugao Port Authority, major natural harbor on Zuari River estuary in Goa, handling iron ore and coal.
ports.license: Government of India Open Data / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Breakwater protected fairway; pilot boarding ground west of breakwater.

ports.name: New Mangalore
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (12°55'N, 74°49'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 44160. New Mangalore Port Authority in Panambur, Karnataka; major hub for coffee, crude, LPG, and fertilizer.
ports.license: Government of India Open Data / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Lagoon harbor with breakwaters; draft limitations during southwest monsoon.

ports.name: Ennore (Kamarajar Port)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (13°16'N, 80°20'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 44265. Kamarajar Port Limited, corporatized major port north of Chennai handling coal, cars, and LNG.
ports.license: Government of India Open Data / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Artificial deep-water port with round-the-clock navigation.

ports.name: Pipavav
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (20°55'N, 71°30'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 44075. APM Terminals Pipavav, all-weather deep-water port in Gulf of Khambhat.
ports.license: Government of India Open Data / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Dedicated pilotage; tidal currents in Gulf of Khambhat.

ports.name: Kattupalli
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (13°19'N, 80°21'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 44267. Adani Kattupalli Port north of Ennore; modern multi-purpose dry bulk and container terminal.
ports.license: Government of India Open Data / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Enclosed harbour basin with deep draft.

ports.name: Haldia
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (22°01'N, 88°04'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 44385. Haldia Dock Complex (HDC) of SMP Kolkata, deepwater dock for bulk coal, petrochem, and edible oils.
ports.license: Government of India Open Data / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Hooghly estuary navigation; lock entrance into impounded wet dock system.

ports.name: Singapore
ports.provenance: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) Port Marine Circulars. Western Pilot Boarding Ground A (01°13.1'N, 103°38.0'E; 103.6500, 1.2200). NGA Pub. 150 Index 49990.
ports.license: Official Port Notice (Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore)
ports.access_limitations: Western Singapore Strait TSS fairway entrance. Heavy commercial traffic and mandatory pilotage.

ports.name: Rotterdam
ports.provenance: Netherlands Hydrographic Service Chart 122 (Mond van de Maas). Maas Center Light Buoy (52°00.0'N, 003°51.0'E; 3.8500, 52.0000). NGA Pub. 150 Index 34100.
ports.license: Official Navigational Chart (Netherlands Hydrographic Service)
ports.access_limitations: Eurogeul approach channel in North Sea for Maasvlakte deep-draft terminals.

ports.name: Balboa (Panama Pacific)
ports.provenance: Autoridad del Canal de Panamá (ACP) Navigation Regulations (OP Notice N-1-2024). Pacific Sea Buoy 1/2 (-79.5167, 8.8500). NGA Pub. 150 Index 09490.
ports.license: Official Maritime Regulation (Autoridad del Canal de Panamá)
ports.access_limitations: Pacific canal approach fairway. Transit requires ACP transit reservation slot, line-handlers, and official ACP pilotage.

ports.name: Cristobal (Panama Atlantic)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (09°21'N, 79°54'W). NGA Pub. 150 Index 09470. Atlantic entrance to Panama Canal (Manzanillo Bay / Limon Bay).
ports.license: Official Maritime Regulation (ACP) / UNECE UN/LOCODE
ports.access_limitations: Atlantic anchorage and breakwater channel under ACP control.

ports.name: Port Said (Suez North)
ports.provenance: Suez Canal Authority (SCA) Rules of Navigation. Port Said Fairway Light Buoy (31°24.0'N, 032°21.0'E; 32.3500, 31.4000). NGA Pub. 150 Index 45010.
ports.license: Official Navigation Rules (Suez Canal Authority)
ports.access_limitations: Northern Mediterranean fairway approach for southbound Suez Canal convoy formation; subject to convoy scheduling and SCA pilotage.

ports.name: Suez (Port Tewfik)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (29°57'N, 32°33'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 45040. Southern Red Sea terminus of Suez Canal at Gulf of Suez.
ports.license: Official Navigation Rules (Suez Canal Authority)
ports.access_limitations: Northbound convoy staging area in Suez Roads.

ports.name: Baku
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 Port Directory centroid (40°22'N, 49°50'E; 49.8333, 40.3667). Stored prototype test coordinate used exclusively as disconnected inland water test point.
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use (UNECE UN/LOCODE Directory)
ports.access_limitations: Caspian Sea landlocked/endorheic water body; no deep-water ocean connectivity to global oceanic sea-lane network without inland Volga-Don river-canal system.

ports.name: Jebel Ali (Dubai)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (25°01'N, 55°04'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 48285. Largest marine terminal in the Middle East and major transshipment hub for Gulf-India trades.
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / DP World
ports.access_limitations: Strait of Hormuz transit and deep-water approach channel.

ports.name: Shanghai (Yangshan)
ports.provenance: UN/LOCODE 2024-1 centroid (31°14'N, 121°30'E). NGA Pub. 150 Index 57700. World's busiest container and bulk port complex on Yangtze River estuary and Hangzhou Bay (Yangshan Deepwater Port).
ports.license: Open UN Terms of Use / SIPG
ports.access_limitations: Yangtze Estuary Deepwater Channel; mandatory pilotage for foreign vessels.
